title: TrafficHD: Efficient Hyperdimensional Computing for Real-Time Network Traffic Analytics
problem: Network traffic classification must handle high-dimensional data from modern infrastructure and meet real-time processing requirements that conventional machine learning algorithms cannot satisfy.
motivation: Real-time network traffic analytics is critical as network patterns become increasingly complex, requiring more efficient and faster processing solutions than traditional machine learning approaches.
method: TrafficHD leverages Hyperdimensional Computing to transform network traffic features into high-dimensional binary vectors. It exploits HDC's power efficiency and inherent parallelism to enable rapid classification within real-time system constraints.
key_novelty: Application of hyperdimensional computing to network traffic classification, achieving significant speedups while maintaining robustness to network noise.
contributions: TrafficHD framework applying HDC to real-time network traffic classification
30.57× speedup over state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms

metrics.speedup: 30.57× over SOTA ML, 98.32× over SOTA HDC
